to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the February 28, 2008/Phalguna 9, 1929 (Saka)

(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and
Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road Transport
and Highways; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation;
Urban Development; Youth
Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions  20
14
Sethusamudram Canal
*41. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether according to the book
entitled "Images India", published by NRSA
(National Remote Sensing Agency),
satellite images have revealed that "an
ancient bridge existed between India and
Sri Lanka in Palk Strait";
(b) if so, whether Government is also
aware that a large number of people in the
country consider Ram Setu/Adams bridge,
a national monument due to its antiquity
and unique features/historical importance
in Ram Charit Manas; and
(c) if so, Government's final decision
regarding construction of Sethusamudram
Canal by dredging a portion of Ram Setu
and whether the same has been conveyed
to the Supreme Court?
Preparations for Beijing Olympics
*42. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the preparations made for winning
more medals in the forthcoming Beijing
Olympics;
(b) whether any steps have been taken
to sort out the problems being faced by our
athletes and sports persons which prevent
them from winning medals at Olympic
Games even though we are the second largest
country in the world;
(c) if so, the specific steps taken by
Government during each of the last three
years in this regard and the sports and
events in which our sports-persons are
expected to excel during the forthcoming
Olympic games; and
(d) the amount spent by the Union
Government on preparations for Olympics,
so far?

15
Employees in PSUs under CIT
*43. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of permanent employees
working in PSUs under the administrative
control of his Ministry as on 31 March,
2007, unit-wise break-up; and
(b) the number of contract/casual/
contingency workers working in each of
these units as on 31 March, 2007?
Software for registered farmers
*44. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of  COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether IIT, Bombay has developed
a software with which registered farmers
can have their queries answered on a  mobile
phone without having to go to a kiosk or
cyber cafe;
(b) if so, will farmers from Vidarbha
region be made familiar with such a cost-
effective mechanism through which they
get answers to their agriculture and animal
husbandry related questions; and
(c) the cost involved and the time-frame
for starting the functioning of this software
from Vidarbha?
Reducing CER at garbage dumps
*45. SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of  URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has issued
directions to different Municipalities and
State Governments to cut Carbon Emission
Rates (CER) by treating the garbage dumps
using new capping techniques and
economizing the space covered by dumping
grounds; and
(b) if so, the CERs earned thereby by
Municipalities in different metropolises per
annum as a result of such efforts?
Completion of EW and NS corridors
*46. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) by when the East-West and North-
South corridors of the National Highways
would be completed;
(b) the distance in kilometres that needs
to be completed; and
(c) the problems being faced in its
completion?
Extraction of dolomite from Bhutan
*47. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to refer
to the answer to Unstarred Question 467
given in the Rajya Sabha on 22nd
November, 2007 and state:
(a) when was the Joint Technical Team
constituted; and
(b) the action taken on the
recommendation of the Joint Technical
Team so far?
Shift in flow of Ganga river
*48. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to worst
environmental conditions on the Gangotri

16
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
glacier in the Himalaya Mountain, the flow
of river Ganga has gone for away from the
main source 'Gaumukh';
(b)  if so, whether any survey has been
conducted in this regard;
(c) if so, the details and the outcome
thereof; and
(d) the steps taken/being taken by
Government to bring back the flow of river
Ganga to 'Gaumukh'?
Notification of rules under the Forest
Act
*49. SHRI KALRAJ
